profile.one_liner: Gini offers needle-free, at-home blood testing for women, timed to the menstrual cycle, with doctor-reviewed results and clear next steps.
profile.product: A pre-launch kit of two at-home, needle-free blood collections (FDA-cleared device, CLIA/CAP lab) timed to the user's cycle. It covers a panel of about 24 markers, including reproductive hormones, thyroid, HbA1c, lipids/ApoB, ferritin, hsCRP, kidney/liver and vitamin D. Results are interpreted alongside cycle and symptoms, doctor-reviewed, and paired with guidance on what to discuss with a physician.
profile.customers: Consumer women (direct-to-consumer, HSA/FSA eligible) with symptoms such as fatigue, weight gain, irregular periods, acne/hirsutism, hair thinning or hot flashes. Named segments include women exploring PCOS/PMOS, women in perimenopause, women on GLP-1s, and women wanting a health baseline. The waitlist has 5,000+ sign-ups.
profile.value_prop: Cycle-aware timing with two draws gives hormone results proper context, which single-draw tests lack. It is convenient and needle-free at home, with physician-reviewed, plain-language interpretation and next steps.
gaps: Clinical care/telehealth partner to diagnose, prescribe and treat (e.g., PCOS, perimenopause HRT) beyond 'wellness insights'
Distribution via employers, women's health benefits platforms and payers, since the company is pre-launch, DTC and waitlist-only
Referral channels from OB-GYNs, fertility clinics and GLP-1/weight-management programs
Integrations with cycle-tracking apps and wearables for cycle timing and symptom data
Brand trust and reach beyond founder Instagram (@doctor.kenza) via established women's health brands
profile.geography: Likely United States (HSA/FSA, CLIA, HIPAA, FDA references); not explicitly stated

email.subject: Cycle-timed labs + perimenopause patients for Midi
email.body:
Hi there,

Midi has built insurance-covered virtual care purpose-built for perimenopause and menopause, and a big part of that care depends on knowing where a woman is hormonally before her first visit.

Gini Health is a needle-free, at-home blood test timed to the menstrual cycle. Two draws cover about 24 markers, including reproductive hormones, thyroid, HbA1c, ApoB and ferritin, with doctor-reviewed results. Your clinicians would get hormone data in proper cycle context. Many of the women on our 5,000+ waitlist are in perimenopause and need a clinic that can diagnose and treat.

One idea is a two-way referral pilot. We send Gini users who need HRT evaluation to Midi, and Midi patients can use Gini for cycle-timed labs at home.

Open to a 20-minute call to explore it?

[Your name]
Gini Health
